{{Quote|The Emperor himself chose the banner of Lord Nankrang. He foresaw Nankrang's triumph over the Jedi in the Mid Rim. It's why we honor him tonight.|[[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]]|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
In [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="BotEDate" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an '''engagement''' occurred in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The conflict was fought between the forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nankrang]] and those of the Republic's allies in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Nankrang was chosen to lead the operation by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] received a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] that depicted Nankrang's victory. That vision came to fruition in the Mid Rim, and Nankrang overcame the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who opposed him and claimed victory for the Empire. The achievement was celebrated on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], along with those of [[Darth Ekkage]] and Lord [[Malichose]].<ref name="BotE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The engagement in the Mid Rim was first mentioned in [[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith|''Shades of the Sith'']], the first act in the three-part [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] story arc, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]''. ''Shades of the Sith'', released in [[2010]], mentioned the conflict in the Mid Rim but gave no context outside of the Emperor's vision and Lord Nankrang's involvement.<ref name="BotE1" />
